name: qa_song
title: SONG-UX: the pads on the Song screen (OS-SONGPADS: Shift + F7 PADS, TRACKS mute / solo, SLOTS tap = move the cursor stopped, queue the slot's jump while playing, the LEDs and the page of 48) and, with OS-SONGMAP, the track map's cursor, selection, copy / paste / clear, TOOLS, UNIQUE and the question; OS-SONGSHARE: the shared-pattern mark, CUT (Shift + Delete), MOVE (Copy held + Up / Down) and NEXT USE (Note / Shift + Note). Changes the open project's song, patterns, mute and solo flags (every step is taken back with F8; do not save it)

steps.say: OS-SONGPADS, rows QA-SNG-040..046 of docs/qa/catalogue. Needs the t-v16 project open (a song of several slots), the transport stopped and the Song screen's pads in TRACKS at boot (the mode is not saved), and the TOOLS dialog as it is at boot (OP TRANSPOSE, AMOUNT 0): the dialog keeps its OP and AMOUNT for the session (SONG-UX D7) and a complete run puts them back at its end, so a second run in the same boot starts clean; after a run that stopped midway, reboot the unit. New Community OS behaviour: the Song screen's pads did nothing before

steps.say: OS-SONG-FORM (docs/specs/OS-SONG-BUILD.md), rows QA-SNG-097..106: FORM, the fifth OP of the TOOLS dialog, builds the slots of a song shape after the selected slots, with copies of the source pattern whose kick, rest of the drums or music tracks are empty. Needs a project whose slot 0 holds a pattern with music on tracks 5..12 (t-v16) and room for 4 patterns and 9 slots; by ear: the first slot of the POP form has no drums but the music, the third no kick. Changes the song (taken back with F8). New Community OS behaviour

Needs slots 0 and 1 to hold two different patterns (t-v16) and room for 4 patterns and 4 slots; by ear: the first new slot is mostly A, the last mostly B. Changes the song (taken back with F8). steps.say: The TOOLS dialog goes back to its boot state for the next run of this scenario in the same boot (SONG-UX D7: it keeps its OP and AMOUNT for the session; the state line does not show the OP, so a run cannot find it from an unknown one, it leaves it as it found it): OP from BRIDGE (the last, OS-SONG-BRIDGE) rolls over to TRANSPOSE, AMOUNT from +5 back to 0

steps.note: OP: BRIDGE rolls over to TRANSPOSE
to the AMOUNT row
AMOUNT to its lower end, -24 (the unit accelerates a burst of detents, so it is turned well past the end)
... and up to 0, one detent at a time
BACK: nothing is applied
